fact: 36 per cent of the population of Cote d'Ivoire used the internet in 2021, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
38.4 per cent of the population of Cote d'Ivoire used the internet in 2022, a survey figure the country reported to the International Telecommunication Union.
40.7 per cent of the population of Cote d'Ivoire used the internet in 2023, a survey figure the country reported to the International Telecommunication Union.
41.4 per cent of the population of Cote d'Ivoire used the internet in 2024, a survey figure the country reported to the International Telecommunication Union.
The INS survey presented on 23 April 2024, carried out at the end of 2023, found that 50% of Ivorians have access to the internet, 65.7% in towns and 29.4% in rural areas.
